prompt:
Create a single convincing 9:16 smartphone mirror selfie of a fictional 25-year-old adult woman getting ready to go out. She is exceptionally attractive, with the presence of a confident fashion creator. The photograph should feel spontaneous and personal, not like an AI beauty advertisement.

The figure is the main compositional priority. Show her from the top of her head to just above the knees, close enough that her body fills the vertical frame. She has a naturally curvy, softly athletic hourglass figure: a proportionate full bust, a distinctly defined waist, rounded hips and strong graceful thighs. Keep normal adult anatomy and a believable ribcage and pelvis. Her torso, waist and hips must be clearly readable.

She wears an opaque fitted black square-neck mini dress in substantial matte stretch cotton, with wide shoulder straps and a hem above the knees. It is a normal going-out dress, fully covering the chest and torso. It follows the waist and hips without looking painted on. Show small diagonal tension folds where the fabric meets her waist, a slight seam shadow and ordinary wrinkles where she shifts her weight. The cut and body language should make the silhouette striking.

Her body is turned about 25 degrees to the mirror, with her weight settled onto her back leg, one hip slightly to the side and the nearer knee relaxed. Her shoulders are loose; her back is neutral. One hand lifts her long hair behind the ear while the other holds the phone beside her face at the outer right edge. She tilts her chin down just slightly and looks toward the reflected camera with a quiet, confident half-smile. Her figure stays unobstructed by the phone.

Give her an individual adult face: high but soft cheekbones, a slightly tapered jaw, deep-set almond hazel-brown eyes, strong natural brows and full lips with a muted rosy tint. Very long dark chocolate hair with a center part and softly curved ends, mostly brushed behind the shoulders so it does not hide the waist. A few loose strands cross one shoulder. Minimal soft-glam makeup and small gold earrings, with a delicate necklace. Skin is warm olive with believable tonal variation and subtle everyday texture. Preserve slight asymmetry.

The mirror is in a tasteful lived-in apartment dressing area: warm off-white walls, dark oak door, a softly rumpled cream jacket on the edge of a chair. The background is secondary. A broad window just outside the frame on the left gives soft directional daylight, with gentle shadows on the far side of her face and waist. Use normal neutral-warm phone white balance. No orange cast, spotlight, flash, ring light or cinematic rim light.

Use ordinary smartphone photo mode, main rear camera through the mirror, held around cheek height and tilted slightly downward. The phone has a plain dark translucent case with a physically consistent three-lens camera cluster. Show correct reflected hands and realistic grip. Keep the image handheld and a little imperfect: slight off-center framing, natural perspective, sharp eyes, softer fine detail toward the edges, a tiny amount of shadow noise and restrained processing. Background objects remain recognizable.

Do not make every pore, hair and fabric fiber equally crisp. Avoid airbrushed skin, glossy plastic faces, repeated freckles, synthetic eyelashes, exaggerated proportions, a pinched waist, doll features, rigid posing, impossible mirror geometry, extra fingers, warped phone cameras, artificial background blur, HDR halos, watermarks or text.

The desired result is a beautiful, fully clothed adult fashion selfie whose appeal comes from her figure, expression and styling, and whose realism comes from coherent light, natural posture and ordinary photographic imperfections.
